main_text.p: ܝܫܡܐ Syr. Exemplar libri, ut Schind. explicat. Occurrit in Testam. Viennensi in Præfat. de Erratis Typograph.
צחצח Pahel Ch. Tergere, extergere, polire, expolire.
צחצוח Ch. Polities, coruscatio, nitor, fulgor, splendor. Plur. צחצוחין.
בצחצחן Ch. Eleganter, nitidè, politè, Jesa.32.4.
צחן צחנא Ch. Putor, putredo, fœtor: Fluxus.
ܨܚܢܐ Syr. Idem, juxta Tremell. & Jun. quorum notæ videantur, Marc.7.22. & ad Galat.5.19. 1.Pet. 4.3. Respondet Græco ἀσέλγεια. In Regiis redditur, Protervia.
צטר צטרא Ch. Latus, ora, extremitas: Idem quod טר, Genef.6.19.in Jon. Sic בצטר Apud, juxta, penes.
ציב צבא Chald. Currus tectus, cameratus; Lectica, Nah.2.7. Plur. ציבין Jesa.49.22.

ציץ ציצא Ch. Bractea, Lamina, Exo.28.36. Cant.5.14. Deinde est nomen avis immundæ, respondens Hebræo תחמס, quod Hirundinem explicant, Lev. 11.16. Item Nomen lapidis pretiosi, scintillantis & splendentis, Rubinus, Esth.1.2.in Targ.sec.
ציצין Ch. Pinnæ piscium, Levit.11.9.10. Alæ, Psal.139.9. Sed Num.24.24. in Targ. Jon. respondet Hebræo צים Naves, quod Onkelos transfert ציין Copiæ, turmæ, T.H. אוכלסין Populi.
ציצית Ch. Cincinnus, peniculamentu, Peniculatus filorum textus. Plur. ציצין, ציציתא, Num.16.2.in Jon.& 15.38.ubi in Targ.Hierosl.punctatur ציץ masculinè.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek words are rendered as far as legible; the Syriac and some pointed Hebrew forms are uncertain at the scan resolution. Line-end catchword not present.
